pick.name: Inngest
pick.what: Durable step functions, events, crons, retries, flow control (TS/Python/Go)
pick.why: Works on serverless and servers with zero queue infra; step-level durability fits AI agent pipelines
pick.free_limits: Free: 50,000 executions/mo (each run and each step counts), 5 concurrent steps, 5 seats, 24h traces, pauses at quota; Pro from $99/mo
pick.license: SDKs Apache-2.0; server SSPL w/ delayed Apache (DOSP)

alts.name: DBOS Transact
alts.what: Durable workflows + queues as a library on Postgres (TS/Python/Go/Java)
alts.why: $0 forever with no vendor or quota - only needs Postgres and a long-running process

alts.name: Trigger.dev
alts.what: Long-running TS tasks with managed compute
alts.why: Best for minutes-to-hours AI jobs without your own workers
alts.free_limits: Free: $5/mo credits, 20 concurrent runs, 1-day logs, 10 schedules; Hobby $10/mo; self-host free

candidates.name: Inngest (pick)
candidates.verdict: Zero-ops durable steps; watch the step-counted quota and the $99 jump.

candidates.name: DBOS
candidates.verdict: Wins when you run a persistent Node/Python server on Postgres: no quota, MIT, lowest exit cost.

candidates.name: Trigger.dev
candidates.verdict: Wins for long compute-heavy tasks; cheaper first paid tier ($10).

candidates.name: pg-boss 12
candidates.verdict: Simple Postgres queue (MIT); no durable steps.

candidates.name: BullMQ 6
candidates.verdict: Redis queue; adds Redis to run.

candidates.name: Temporal
candidates.verdict: Gold standard but heavy to self-host; cloud is paid.

candidates.name: Cloudflare Workflows
candidates.verdict: Good if everything is on Workers; platform lock-in.

decision: Inngest is the lowest-effort durable workflow engine that works on any host, which suits a solo dev shipping AI pipelines. Switch to DBOS once you run a long-lived API server on Postgres or approach 50k executions/month, to avoid the $99 tier.
note: Consolidated: start with Cloudflare Queues (ship track) and add Inngest only when a job is a multi-step LLM workflow that needs step-level retries.

verify.note: Version/licence/limits match registry or official page.
